subject.title: [Bug]: Slack provider doesn't reliably reload after channels.slack.botToken rotation (cached singleAuthorization)

question: Should maintainers require a current-main or v2026.6.11 Sandpaw/container reproduction before choosing watcher hardening or config.patch restart hardening for this issue?
rationale: The source path already restarts Slack for `channels.slack.*` changes, while the only remaining failure mode is environment/control-plane specific and not yet tied to one layer.

options.title: Require targeted reproduction
options.body: Keep this issue open until a container or Control UI/config.patch save shows watcher status, logs, filesystem details, and whether `restarting slack channel` was skipped.

options.title: Harden watcher/control-plane proactively
options.body: Accept a speculative fix against the suspected watcher or config.patch path, with the risk that it does not address the reporter's actual failure mode.

options.title: Close as unreproduced later
options.body: If no current-main or newest-release reproduction arrives after a reasonable window, close with the direct-edit proof and ask for a new report with container diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Require targeted reproduction
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a container or Control UI/config.patch save shows watcher status, logs, filesystem details, and whether `restarting slack channel` was skipped.
